summary: Full 90-day high-stress warring_states run completed (exit 0, no timeout) -- the only opportunity to validate churn-fix at the original catastrophic-explosion scale. Team explosion is clearly suppressed (49->152 vs original 49->242, trajectory plateaus from day50 rather than climbing unbounded) -- this is the strongest positive result. Pop-cap distribution stays healthy (0 runaway both directions, cap<5 rate flat vs prior round). Item 1's organic facility-development question resolves clean: no cap-correlated structural facility-development block found, fixture fix alone suffices, no production floor needed. However item 3's other two axes are NOT clean wins: perf's absolute numbers are roughly comparable to original but per-team cost did not improve (and the max/avg spike ratio is nearly identical to original, ~26x both times), and the raw same-pair-repeat churn signature (1647 lines/136 pairs/max 81x) came out HIGHER than the original's cited 698/54x -- the opposite of what a successful churn-fix should show, though this comparison's validity is undermined by not knowing whether the original run reached full duration before being cut short by its own explosion. Recommend systems reconcile the original run's actual elapsed coverage before treating the same-pair-repeat regression as real, and have implementer confirm the dispatch-counter/raw-line-count print-call-site discrepancy (512 vs 1647) before calling item 3 closed.
